identity.disambiguation_notes: Identity confirmed via multiple sources: (1) Official Gentosha Gold Online author profile confirming Chairman of Sony Global Education since June 2022, (2) ZoomInfo/RocketReach listing him as Corporate Distinguished Engineer at Sony Group with prior roles at Sony Network Communications and S.BLOX Inc., (3) Gate.io article confirming him as Director at Startale Labs alongside Jun Watanabe, Sota Watanabe, and others. Note: Sony Global Education's current President/CEO is Naoki Kato (加藤直樹) as of recent website check; Isozu transitioned to Chairman role in June 2022. S.BLOX's current Representative Director is Jun Watanabe (渡辺潤), not Isozu—Isozu's connection appears to be through Startale Labs directorship and prior Sony Network Communications roles.

role_scope.summary: Masaaki Isozu is the founding Chairman of Sony Global Education (SGE), the first education company within Sony Group, established in 2015. He served as President/CEO until June 2022, then transitioned to Chairman. He also serves as a Director at Startale Labs (the Web3 infrastructure company that co-developed Soneium with Sony) and holds the title of Corporate Distinguished Engineer at Sony Group. His career spans 20+ years at Sony, starting as a software engineer in 2000, moving to Sony Computer Science Laboratory (Sony CSL) in 2012 for new business incubation, then founding SGE in 2015. He has deep expertise in education technology, blockchain applications in education, and STEAM/programming education. He is also an outside director at Choshi Electric Railway and serves on Z-kai's scholarship selection committee.

decision_criteria.hypothesis: Prioritizes long-term educational impact over short-term ROI—values '300-year vision' for education transformation
decision_criteria.evidence: SGE's stated vision is '300年先の未来をつくる教育' (Creating education for 300 years in the future). His book and interviews consistently emphasize generational impact over immediate returns.

decision_criteria.hypothesis: Values technology that enhances human individuality rather than replacing it—sees AI and blockchain as complementary tools for human development
decision_criteria.evidence: Stated in interviews: 'Humans are versatile beings...their imperfections are what make them so interesting. We aim for coexistence of AI and its optimal solutions with humans and their diverse sensibilities.' Also: 'History proves that innovation is created from versatility. It is not possible to replace human individuality.'

decision_criteria.hypothesis: Prefers solutions with clear educational data sovereignty and portability benefits—blockchain for credential verification and lifelong learning records
decision_criteria.evidence: Developed blockchain-based education platform with IBM; stated 'We want to keep life-long learning records...securely in the cloud forever' and 'Based on blockchain technology, this information becomes a valuable asset.'

decision_criteria.hypothesis: Receptive to solutions that bridge Web2 and Web3 for mainstream adoption—interested in practical blockchain applications, not speculation
decision_criteria.evidence: Soneium is explicitly positioned to 'link Web2 and Web3' and bring blockchain to everyday life. SGE's blockchain work focuses on practical education use cases (credentials, learning records), not crypto trading.

decision_criteria.hypothesis: Values global scalability and cross-border applicability—interested in solutions that work across education systems internationally
decision_criteria.evidence: SGE's products (KOOV, Global Math Challenge) operate globally; blockchain credential work explicitly aimed at cross-border verification. His book discusses overseas education models.
